title: NexaCore
build_command: docker run --rm -u 1000:1000 -e HOME=/tmp -v "$PWD:/work" -w /work --entrypoint sh louislam/uptime-kuma:2 -c 'npm ci && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build'
asset_issues: All supplied media and font URLs retrieved successfully; see asset-report.json.
Original NexaCore visual preview was absent at its specified path.
The prompt references an exact Control chip SVG path without supplying it; a heart path was reconstructed from the description.
Hero media range requests sometimes report net::ERR_ABORTED while decoded video continues playing successfully.
notes: Ready for acceptance review; not deployed or pushed.
React 18.3 / TypeScript 5.5 / Vite / Tailwind 3.4; lucide-react and hls.js used.
The invalid package name @supabase/Bolt Database-js was interpreted as @supabase/supabase-js, installed but unwired.
Contact uses an email composer with no recipient because no contact address was supplied.
Both Chromium viewports passed interaction, media, error and overflow assertions. Safari native HLS fallback implemented but untested.
Build has a nonfatal hls.js bundle size warning. Requested Vite 5 dependency tree reports two npm audit findings; details in README.md.
All source, local assets, build, reports and screenshots remain in this project. node_modules removed after validation.
